description: Answers "did my swap go through?" in plain terms. Returns a status (not_found, pending, streaming, sent, refunded, completed), whether it is done, a one-line summary to tell the user, streaming progress, an estimated wait, and the refund reason. refund=true with status sent means part was refunded. Start here for swap tracking; use get_tx_status only for raw stage detail.

hash.description: The deposit (inbound) transaction hash: the hash of what the user sent to THORChain. A 0x prefix is fine.

name: get_swap_status
title: Get Swap Status
